scope: 86 independent four-face previews, each joining one adaptively subdivided flagged face to its three edge neighbors. No global mesh replacement.
method: Root barycentric grid at the first passing v0.124 density. Neighbor fan from its mapped native centroid to the root shared edge and its two unchanged outside edges. Shared root-edge indices are reused exactly. Original registered source corners are pinned before local float32 storage; rounding recorded. No stitching between independent previews.
license: BigBrain derivatives CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; transform notices and original citations retained via referenced provenance.
limits: Conforming topology does not imply correct geometric orientation or anatomical accuracy
Neighbor fan orientation alerts are preserved and displayed, never hidden
Shared index identity is exact; outer corners have recorded float32 storage rounding
Patches overlap their unchanged coarse cortex in this diagnostic preview; no production replacement
Independent previews may overlap each other; they are not a single unified mesh
Sampled centre checks do not certify full interiors, volume, global injectivity or self-intersections
No acquired microstructures, neuronal activity or biological latency added
